individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each marker is an individual sample measurement (n=141); marginal histograms show distributions. Individual points are the data itself.
Scatter plot with each marker representing a cell line/reporter mean plus error bars; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid raw points.
Smoothed density/distribution curves (normal/gamma distributions) analogous to line plots; overlaying individual points would be unreadable and is not required for this plot type.
Box plots already show distribution via quartiles/whiskers, and individual sample data points (circles/dots per cell line and reporter) are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms display frequency/probability distributions of phase differences (aggregated bins), not mean bar charts; individual point overlay is not applicable to histogram bins.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; a frequency distribution plot, not a mean bar chart requiring individual point overlay.
Single example raw signal trace with fitted decay model illustrating the analysis method; not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot where each marker is an individual sample (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; individual points are the data itself.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - no error bars are present in this scatter/histogram panel.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - caption explicitly states error bars represent mean +/- standard deviation with sample sizes specified.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median, outliers) are all explicitly defined in the caption.
